en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes up 116 points to end three-day decline
en.dek: The benchmark finished at 23,753 on turnover of about HK$174 billion, with mainland banks and consumer shares supporting gains while the tech index edged lower.
body: The Hang Seng Index closed 116 points, or 0.5 per cent, higher at 23,753 on Monday, ending a three-day losing streak, according to market reports.
Turnover reached about HK$174 billion. The China Enterprises Index rose 44 points, or 0.6 per cent, while the Hang Seng Tech Index fell 11 points, or 0.3 per cent.

Mainland bank stocks and consumer shares provided support. New World Development shares plunged on its rights issue, a development already reported separately. Regional tech concerns linked to AI hardware continued to weigh on some shares.

zh.headline: 恒生指數收升116點 結束三日跌勢
zh.dek: 大市成交約1740億港元，收報23753點；內銀及消費股支持升勢，科技指數微跌。
body: 恒生指數周一收市上升116點，或0.5%，報23753點，結束連續三日下跌，市場消息指。
全日成交額約1740億港元。恒生中國企業指數升44點，或0.6%；恒生科技指數則跌11點，或0.3%。
內銀股及消費股提供支持。新世界發展因供股股價大跌，相關消息已另有報道。區域科技股憂慮持續影響部分股份。
